name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=play/dialog, descriptor=open_animation). Accurately reflects purpose: animate a dialog box opening then assemble its 5-layer frame. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Animate a portrait dialog box opening (optional cursor-pan + linear-interpolated sprite slide), then assemble the 5-layer dialog frame, returning the head of the 5-buffer screen-save array used to restore the screen when the dialog closes.
logic_summary: If dst_origin (param flip) == 0, infer it from the active portrait mode: data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset 0x728 (enemy/slot1) -> 2, 0x9017 (ally/slot2) -> 0x70. Otherwise: clear data_fd2_battle_anim_phase, fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated(pos_x,pos_y), set phase=1, compute cursor pixel origin (cursor_x/y * 0x18 + 4) and total_steps = cursor_screen_x + cursor_screen_y; if non-zero, run an interpolation loop step=0..total_steps that blits an indexed sprite (from data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr + *(int16*)(sheet+6)) sliding from the cursor pixel toward dst_origin via fd2_blit_indexed_sprite_with_alloc into slot[0], delays 10ms, clears the keyboard buffer, and restores via fd2_cleanup_dialog_sprite_buffer. Then always: malloc 5 x 0x682C save buffers into data_fd2_dialog_dialog_frame_layer_save_buffer_ptrs[0..4]; compute width = dst_origin*0x140 + 5; run 5 frame-assembly stages (sprite groups 4/8/0xC/0x10/0x13 with row counts 2/3/4/5/5), each saving the underlying screen band first via fd2_save_screen_block_to_buffer then composing via fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered, with 10ms delays between the first four. Finally clear the keyboard buffer and return the head of the 5-buffer save array.
signature: uint32 fd2_play_dialog_open_animation(uint32 pos_x, uint32 pos_y, uint32 flip)

params.name: pos_x
params.semantics: Tile X (pos_x) of the speaking character; passed to fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated as the cursor pan target (only used on the flip!=0 path). Caller always supplies speaker->pos_x.
params.reason: Matches caller-supplied runtime_char pos_x and its only use as the cursor-pan X target.

params.name: pos_y
params.semantics: Tile Y (pos_y) of the speaking character; passed to fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated as the cursor pan Y target (flip!=0 path). Caller always supplies speaker->pos_y.
params.reason: Matches caller-supplied runtime_char pos_y and its only use as the cursor-pan Y target.

params.name: flip
params.semantics: Destination origin / vertical slot offset for the dialog frame (NOT a boolean flip flag). 0 => infer from portrait mode (enemy 0x728 -> 2, ally 0x9017 -> 0x70); otherwise used as the slide target (cursor_y_pixel - flip), as the frame width factor (flip*0x140 + 5), and as fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered's row_offset. Caller passes portrait_slot_offset (0 / 2 / 0x70).
params.reason: Current name 'flip' implies a boolean mirror/flip flag, but the value is an origin/row offset (2 or 0x70) used as the interpolation target, width factor, and assemble row_offset. The Ghidra plate and decomp both call it dst_origin. Rename to dst_origin for accuracy (Stage 2 only; not applied here).

returns.semantics: Address of data_fd2_dialog_dialog_frame_layer_save_buffer_ptrs (the head of the 5-pointer screen-save array, @0x53A18). The caller stores it as portrait_anim_state and later passes it to fd2_close_dialog_panels_then_slide_in_at to tear down the dialog and restore the screen.
